messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "inform doctor about history of allergies or asthma"
set: ["inform doctor about history of allergies or asthma", "history of allergies", "history of asthma attack", "inform doctor of history of kidney disease", "inform doctor of history of liver disease", "tell doctor about history of seizures or epilepsy", "tell doctor about history of heart disease", "tell doctor about history of liver or kidney disease", "tell doctor about history of narrow-angle glaucoma", "inform doctor about any changes", "inform treating doctor about use", "inform doctor about alcohol consumption", "inform doctor about low-salt diet", "inform doctor about electrolyte imbalance", "tell doctor about history of bleeding or blood clotting disorder", "tell doctor about history of recent heart attack"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
